Gold chief complaint includes feeling hot/fevers; no such symptom appears in the generated chief complaint.
Gold palpitations are explicitly present in generated chief complaint.

Random timing/at work is captured; presymptoms and ‘sometimes together/individually’ are not mentioned but absence of those details is not a contradiction, so overall considered covered for location/timing.

This differs in diagnostic certainty, so it contradicts the gold assessment that labels hypothyroidism only as a differential.

Gold: plan includes ordering blood tests. Generated plan-003: thyroid studies as blood tests for thyroxine; this is a subset of blood tests, so the core plan is covered.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold chief complaint is simply headaches, loss of appetite, tingling, feeling hot, and palpitations. Generated CC adds intermittent SOB at rest, ~5-lb weight loss, and decreased libido, and omits feeling hot/fevers. It over-expands the chief complaint and excludes one of the listed complaints; this is not supported and conflicts with the defined CC list.

Supported in part by gold hpi-001 and hpi-013 (onset since job change, mainly at work) but adds specific locations (meetings, computer, elevator in AM) not in gold. No direct conflict, so this is an addition.
Frontal, non-radiating headaches with mild nausea match gold hpi-002, hpi-004, and hpi-005. Occurrence during work aligns with gold hpi-013 (symptoms at work).

Gold describes SOB associated with palpitations (hpi-012), not specifically as a breathing issue with headaches. This is a new association (breathing issue with HA) not present in gold. No direct contradiction, so it is an addition.
Gold provides no frequency for palpitations. Generated fact (~1x/day or more) adds new quantitative detail; not contradicted by gold, so it is an addition.

Gold: pins and needles in both arms, no radiation to legs. Generated: bilateral hand tingling 'prickling' and no leg symptoms. This is consistent detail.
Partly aligned with gold hpi-001 (lawyer, computer work, high stress implied) but adds quantified stress (7–8/10) and ‘heavy reading’; these are not in gold and are not contradictory.

Generated: palpitations with intermittent SOB at rest and none with exertion. Gold hpi-012: palpitations with mild SOB on exertion and at rest. The exertional SOB component directly conflicts.
Generated intermittent bilateral hand paresthesias (prickling) matches gold pins and needles in both arms, no leg involvement, though intermittency is added detail.
Decreased appetite and ~5 lb unintentional weight loss are supported by gold hpi-009. Decreased libido and explicit linkage to job change are not present in gold and thus are additions.
